afterImage.name: Caliche Development Partners
afterImage.subsector: Underground natural gas and industrial gas storage
afterImage.description: Caliche Development Partners is a Houston-based underground natural-gas and industrial-gas storage platform whose current operating iteration is Caliche Development Partners III, LLC. Sixth Street owns a majority through Mallard Evergreen Holdings and Caliche Management III retains minority equity and operational leadership. The platform includes Golden Triangle Storage in Texas, Central Valley Gas Storage in California and carbon-sequestration development; these assets and their SPVs are not counted separately.

milestones.event: Caliche was formed with backing from Energy Spectrum Partners VII.
Caliche II, backed by Orion Infrastructure Capital, GCM Grosvenor and management, completed the Golden Triangle Storage acquisition.
Sixth Street completed the Texas portion of its majority investment in Caliche, with management retaining minority equity and operating leadership.
Sixth Street and Caliche completed the Central Valley Gas Storage acquisition, finishing the announced two-stage platform transaction.
Caliche reached a final investment decision for the first phase of the Spindletop storage expansion at Golden Triangle Storage.
